svg.text: Asymptotic safety: G runs between two fixed points (toy one-loop shape)
log of the energy scale k
A genuine dial, but the knob is the energy
scale, not a contraction like c → ∞.
Weak fit (ours): in the variable 1/g the flow
maps are stretch-and-shift maps x → λx + s,
the order dial's affine group, with fixed point
1/g*. Any flow of this one-loop shape does that.
Toy β(g) = 2g − 2g²/g* with g* = 0.7, shape only. Weinberg 1979; Reuter 1998. Checks A1–A2.
